bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Fills a submission form from the record and the user's answers; computes nothing.
bio.jane/contract.question: Fill Addgene's deposit spreadsheet from this record.

description: Fill Addgene's own deposit spreadsheet from a record: one row per plasmid with its name and sequence, plus your answers for every plasmid (purpose, plasmid type, cloning method, resistance, growth strain and the other drop-downs). The sheet is fetched from Addgene each run, so its columns and choices are current; a value it would refuse is left out and named, and `columns` lists every column with its choices. It WRITES A FILE and sends nothing.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

answers.description: the sheet's columns to fill for every plasmid, header → value, e.g. {"Purpose": "Expresses EGFP in E. coli", "Bacterial Resistance": "Ampicillin"}. A drop-down column takes one of its own choices; run once without answers to read them from `columns`.

genbank.description: the plasmids to deposit, as GenBank text: one row per nucleotide record.

name: build_addgene_deposit

columns.description: every column of Addgene's sheet: its header, Addgene's help text, and its choices where it has a drop-down

file.description: the filled workbook: `name`, and its bytes as `base64`

problems.description: every value left out because the sheet would refuse it, with the plasmid, the column and the reason

reading.description: what was written and what is left for the depositor, generated from the run
